category_title: Latino students whose disruptive or defiant behavior is interpreted as 'uncharacteristic'
minimal_context: The student is participating in a language arts lesson while seated near a second-story window overlooking the recess yard.
dialogue:
TUTOR: We are in the middle of our language arts lesson. Please turn to the next page and begin reading.

STUDENT: (Sits at his desk near the second-story window, looking out at the kindergarten class playing at recess in the yard below.)

TUTOR: Please focus on the reading assignment.

STUDENT: (Picks up a heavy metal pencil sharpener dispenser from near his desk instead of looking at the language arts assignment.)

TUTOR: Put that down and get back to work.

STUDENT: (Throws the heavy metal pencil sharpener dispenser out the second-story window, narrowly missing a cluster of kindergartners playing in the yard below, and then immediately looks "scared and sorry".)

options.A: Give a warning, followed by a 10-minute timeout if the student does not desist.
options.B: Provide one out of two choices of reading assignments or potential texts.
options.C: Highlight the value of engagement for pursuing deep learning and improving language arts skills.
options.D: Provide language arts apps that feature instant rewards with audio and text.
